skills.description: Find and run Branchyard document tooling, check its runtime, and prepare file manifests for managed artifact capture.
Create, inspect, update and validate editable Word DOCX documents, preserving source files and checking layout when needed.
Create, inspect, update and validate Excel workbooks, formulas, calculated values and native pivot tables.
Create, extract, overlay and validate PDFs, with rendered checks and explicit limits on document editing.
Create, inspect, update and validate editable PowerPoint decks, including native charts and rendered layout checks.
Create, read and update native Google Docs through an authorized connector, checking actual document identity and revisions.
Create, inspect and update native Google Sheets, including ranges, calculations and pivots supported by the granted connector.
Create, inspect and update native Google Slides through a granted connector while preserving presentation identity, layouts and permissions.
Split a large presentation into independently owned section specifications and assemble checked editable slides with one renderer.
